description: Training load control (ACWR, polarization, CTL/ATL/TSB, monotony/strain, volume, training status, HRV, heat acclimation) + vertical load & terrain (vertical ACWR D+, D+ budget vs ~830 m cap, D+/km, VAM, terrain cost, cumulative elevation gain). Prevents both overall AND vertical overload. Includes the former "Hill & Trail".

panels.description: Garmin training status bands (Productive / Peaking / Maintaining / Recovery / Strained / Unproductive / Detraining / Overreaching). Garmin enum suffix _N indicates duration in state — grouped by main category here.

targets.query: SELECT "trainingStatusFeedbackPhrase" AS Status FROM "TrainingStatus" WHERE $timeFilter

panels.title: Training Status Timeline

panels.description: Garmin trainingBalanceFeedbackPhrase: BALANCED (ideal) / AEROBIC_LOW_FOCUS (base focus = OK for Seiler polarized plan) / AEROBIC_LOW/HIGH_SHORTAGE / ANAEROBIC_SHORTAGE/FOCUS. Garmin _N suffixes stripped via regex.

targets.query: SELECT "trainingBalanceFeedbackPhrase" AS "Load Focus" FROM "TrainingStatus" WHERE $timeFilter

panels.title: Load Focus History

panels.description: Raw Garmin phrase (e.g. PRODUCTIVE_1, MAINTAINING_2, RECOVERY_2). Numeric trainingStatus code not used (mapping uncertain across firmware).
panels.title: Training Status

panels.description: Official Garmin source (trainingBalanceFeedbackPhrase). Requires extended fetcher patch.

targets.query: SELECT last("trainingBalanceFeedbackPhrase") AS "shortage" FROM "TrainingStatus" WHERE $timeFilter

panels.title: Load Focus
Acute vs Chronic Load + Garmin Targets

panels.description: Bands: blue = shortage (below target_min), green = optimal range, red = overload (above target_max). Thresholds calibrated on current Garmin target_min/max (recalibrate if Garmin adjusts).

targets.query: SELECT last("monthlyLoadAnaerobic") AS "an", last("monthlyLoadAnaerobicTargetMin") AS "an_min", last("monthlyLoadAnaerobicTargetMax") AS "an_max", last("monthlyLoadAerobicHigh") AS "hi", last("monthlyLoadAerobicHighTargetMin") AS "hi_min", last("monthlyLoadAerobicHighTargetMax") AS "hi_max", last("monthlyLoadAerobicLow") AS "lo", last("monthlyLoadAerobicLowTargetMin") AS "lo_min", last("monthlyLoadAerobicLowTargetMax") AS "lo_max" FROM "TrainingStatus" WHERE $timeFilter

panels.title: Load Focus 28d — vs Optimal Range

panels.description: Daily history of the 3 loads (rolling 28d) vs Garmin's optimal range. Green band = median of Garmin's min/max targets over the displayed window (stable, robust to occasional ~1.3x target spikes on some days; may differ by +/- a few points from the gauge on the left). Line = today's load; on the right = current value + state (shortage / optimal / overload). Complements the gauge by showing the day-by-day trajectory.

targets.query: SELECT last("monthlyLoadAerobicLow") AS "lo", last("monthlyLoadAerobicLowTargetMin") AS "lo_min", last("monthlyLoadAerobicLowTargetMax") AS "lo_max", last("monthlyLoadAerobicHigh") AS "hi", last("monthlyLoadAerobicHighTargetMin") AS "hi_min", last("monthlyLoadAerobicHighTargetMax") AS "hi_max", last("monthlyLoadAnaerobic") AS "an", last("monthlyLoadAnaerobicTargetMin") AS "an_min", last("monthlyLoadAnaerobicTargetMax") AS "an_max" FROM "TrainingStatus" WHERE $timeFilter GROUP BY time(1d) fill(none)

panels.title: Load Focus 28d — day-by-day history vs optimal range

panels.description: Weekly % time in HR zones (Mon-Sun, Europe/Paris TZ). Garmin colors: Z1+Z2 blue (target >= 80%), Z3 green (target 10%), Z4+Z5 red (target <= 10%). Rolling 12 weeks including current week.

targets.query: SELECT sum("hrTimeInZone_1") + sum("hrTimeInZone_2") AS "Z1+Z2 (target 80%)", sum("hrTimeInZone_3") AS "Z3 (target 10%)", sum("hrTimeInZone_4") + sum("hrTimeInZone_5") AS "Z4+Z5 (target 10%)" FROM "ActivitySummary" WHERE $timeFilter AND "ActivitySelector" =~ /running/ GROUP BY time(7d, 4d) fill(null)

panels.title: Polarization 80/10/10 — Weekly

targets.query: SELECT sum("distance") FROM "ActivitySummary" WHERE $timeFilter AND "ActivitySelector" =~ /running/ GROUP BY time(7d, 4d) fill(0)
SELECT sum("elapsedDuration") FROM "ActivitySummary" WHERE $timeFilter AND "ActivitySelector" =~ /running/ GROUP BY time(7d, 4d) fill(0)

panels.description:
Foster Monotony & Strain (Foster et al., J Strength Cond Res 2001).

Monotony = mean(daily_load_7d) / stddev(daily_load_7d). High monotony (>2.0) = increased illness/staleness risk. Strain = weekly_load × Monotony.

Source: activityTrainingLoad summed daily, running only, rest days = 0. Variance via identity Var(X) = E[X²] - E[X]². Strain = (mean_7d × 7) × Monotony.

Monotony thresholds: <1.5 green (varied), 1.5-2.0 yellow (caution), >2.0 red (risk). Strain: no absolute threshold — watch for >50% spikes above 4-week baseline.

targets.query: SELECT moving_average(daily_tl, 7) / sqrt(moving_average(daily_tl_sq, 7) - moving_average(daily_tl, 7) * moving_average(daily_tl, 7)) AS "Monotony" FROM (SELECT sum("activityTrainingLoad") AS daily_tl, sum("activityTrainingLoad") * sum("activityTrainingLoad") AS daily_tl_sq FROM "ActivitySummary" WHERE $timeFilter AND "ActivitySelector" =~ /running/ GROUP BY time(1d) fill(0))

SELECT (moving_average(daily_tl, 7) * 7) * (moving_average(daily_tl, 7) / sqrt(moving_average(daily_tl_sq, 7) - moving_average(daily_tl, 7) * moving_average(daily_tl, 7))) AS "Strain" FROM (SELECT sum("activityTrainingLoad") AS daily_tl, sum("activityTrainingLoad") * sum("activityTrainingLoad") AS daily_tl_sq FROM "ActivitySummary" WHERE $timeFilter AND "ActivitySelector" =~ /running/ GROUP BY time(1d) fill(0))

panels.title: Foster Monotony & Strain (7d Rolling)

panels.description: Rolling mean approximation of TrainingPeaks EWMA. CTL = 6-week aerobic fitness. ATL = 7-day fatigue. TSB = CTL - ATL: negative = overload, positive = peak form. Competition sweet spot: TSB +5 to +15.

targets.query: SELECT moving_average(daily_tl, 42) AS "CTL (fitness 42d)", moving_average(daily_tl, 7) AS "ATL (fatigue 7d)" FROM (SELECT sum("activityTrainingLoad") AS daily_tl FROM "ActivitySummary" WHERE $timeFilter AND "ActivitySelector" =~ /running/ GROUP BY time(1d) fill(0))

SELECT moving_average(daily_tl, 42) - moving_average(daily_tl, 7) AS "TSB (form)" FROM (SELECT sum("activityTrainingLoad") AS daily_tl FROM "ActivitySummary" WHERE $timeFilter AND "ActivitySelector" =~ /running/ GROUP BY time(1d) fill(0))

panels.title: PMC — Fitness (CTL 42d) / Fatigue (ATL 7d) / Form (TSB)

panels.description: Replicates Garmin Connect HRV Status graph. Grey band = personal baseline. Colored markers by status: green = Balanced, orange = Unbalanced, red = Low.

targets.query: SELECT mean("weeklyAvg") AS "Balanced" FROM "HRVStatus" WHERE "status" = 'BALANCED' AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time(1d) fill(null)
SELECT mean("weeklyAvg") AS "Unbalanced" FROM "HRVStatus" WHERE "status" = 'UNBALANCED' AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time(1d) fill(null)
SELECT mean("weeklyAvg") AS "Low" FROM "HRVStatus" WHERE "status" = 'LOW' AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time(1d) fill(null)

panels.title: HRV Status (7-day avg + baseline)

panels.description: Garmin heat acclimation %. Increases with training in hot conditions. >75% = well acclimated. Seasonal pattern expected.
panels.title: Heat Acclimation (history)

panels.description: Garmin heat acclimation %. >75 = well adapted.

targets.query: SELECT last("heatAcclimationPercentage") AS "Acclim" FROM "HeatAltitudeAcclimation" WHERE $timeFilter GROUP BY time(1d) fill(previous)

panels.title: Heat Acclimation
Vertical ACWR — D+ acute:chronic (the overload guardrail)
panels.description:
Vertical load ratio: rolling 7d mean of daily D+ / rolling 28d mean (Gabbett ACWR windows, applied to D+ — the documented vertical-load factor, not to this dashboard's overall load).
Sweet spot 0.80–1.30 (green) · 1.30–1.50 caution (amber) · >1.50 vertical overload (red).
Today ~0.93. The overload week (17/05) peaked at 1.50. fill(0) = rest days count as 0 D+.

targets.query: SELECT moving_average(d,7)/moving_average(d,28) AS "ACWR D+" FROM (SELECT sum("elevationGain") AS d FROM "ActivitySummary" WHERE "activityType"='running' AND "distance">1000 AND time > now()-400d GROUP BY time(1d) fill(0)) WHERE $timeFilter

panels.title: Vertical ACWR — current
panels.description: Current value of vertical ACWR (same Gabbett bands as the chart). Green = controlled load ramp.

targets.query: SELECT moving_average(d,7)/moving_average(d,28) AS "ACWR D+" FROM (SELECT sum("elevationGain") AS d FROM "ActivitySummary" WHERE "activityType"='running' AND "distance">1000 AND time > now()-400d GROUP BY time(1d) fill(0)) WHERE $timeFilter

panels.title: Weekly D+ + chronic load — vs personal cap
panels.description: Weekly D+ (bars, colored by threshold) vs personal cap (~830 m). Red >800 m, amber >600 m. Dashed grey line = chronic D+ (4-week average). D- has its own dedicated section.

targets.query: SELECT sum("elevationGain") AS "D+" FROM "ActivitySummary" WHERE "activityType"='running' AND "distance">1000 AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time(7d) fill(0)

SELECT moving_average(w,4) AS "D+ chronic (4 wk)" FROM (SELECT sum("elevationGain") AS w FROM "ActivitySummary" WHERE "activityType"='running' AND "distance">1000 AND time > now()-400d GROUP BY time(7d) fill(0)) WHERE $timeFilter

panels.title: Vertical budget 4 wk vs cap
panels.description: Rolling 4-week average of weekly D+ vs your observed cap (~830 m). Translates the abstract ACWR into 'where I stand vs my personal red line'. Currently ~481 m (58%).

targets.query: SELECT moving_average(wk,4) AS "Budget" FROM (SELECT sum("elevationGain") AS wk FROM "ActivitySummary" WHERE "activityType"='running' AND "distance">1000 AND time > now()-400d GROUP BY time(7d) fill(0)) WHERE $timeFilter

panels.title: Climb intensity per run — D+/km (local bands)
panels.description: Climb intensity per run, calibrated to local terrain: <8 flat / 8–15 rolling (your bread and butter) / 15–22 tough / >22 steep (rare, ~5 runs/150d). Red reserved for genuinely hard local runs (no more of the old dashboard's absurd alpine >50 threshold).

targets.query: SELECT ("elevationGain"/("distance"/1000)) AS "D+/km" FROM "ActivitySummary" WHERE "activityType"='running' AND "distance">1000 AND $timeFilter

panels.title: The mountain climbed — cumulative D+ 2026
panels.description: Cumulative running D+ since January 1 (YTD = 9,833 m). Anchored to January 1 — ignores the time picker by design. Grey line = rolling 365d total (12,659 m), the horizon to reach. The slope of the curve = your vertical load; the flats = deloads.

targets.query: SELECT cumulative_sum(wk) AS "Cumulative D+ 2026" FROM (SELECT sum("elevationGain") AS wk FROM "ActivitySummary" WHERE "activityType"='running' AND "distance">1000 AND time >= '2026-01-01T00:00:00Z' GROUP BY time(7d) fill(0))

panels.title: Weekly D- + chronic load — descent
panels.description: Weekly D- (elevation loss), the descent mirror of the D+ panel. Bars colored by threshold (amber >600, red >800), dashed grey line = chronic D- (4-week average). The eccentric load of descent stresses the body differently (muscle damage, tendons).

targets.query: SELECT sum("elevationLoss") AS "D-" FROM "ActivitySummary" WHERE "activityType"='running' AND "distance">1000 AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time(7d) fill(0)

SELECT moving_average(w,4) AS "D- chronic (4 wk)" FROM (SELECT sum("elevationLoss") AS w FROM "ActivitySummary" WHERE "activityType"='running' AND "distance">1000 AND time > now()-400d GROUP BY time(7d) fill(0)) WHERE $timeFilter

panels.title: Vertical D- budget 4 wk vs cap
panels.description: Rolling 4-week average of weekly D- (descent) vs observed cap (~830 m). Descent counterpart of the D+ gauge.

targets.query: SELECT moving_average(wk,4) AS "Budget" FROM (SELECT sum("elevationLoss") AS wk FROM "ActivitySummary" WHERE "activityType"='running' AND "distance">1000 AND time > now()-400d GROUP BY time(7d) fill(0)) WHERE $timeFilter

panels.title: ACWR (acute:chronic load)
panels.description: Acute (7d) / chronic (28d) load ratio, Garmin field dailyAcuteChronicWorkloadRatio — same source as the chart on the right. Gabbett zones: <0.80 undertraining · 0.80–1.30 sweet spot · 1.30–1.50 caution · >1.50 overload. NB: this Garmin field can lag by a few days (the monthly loads, by contrast, are up to date).

targets.query: SELECT last("dailyAcuteChronicWorkloadRatio") AS "ACWR" FROM "TrainingStatus" WHERE $timeFilter GROUP BY time(1d) fill(null)

panels.title: Form (TSB = CTL − ATL)
panels.description: Training Stress Balance = fitness (CTL 42d) − fatigue (ATL 7d), same calculation as the PMC chart on the right. Negative = loaded/fatigued; +5 to +15 = race form; very positive = fresh/detrained.

targets.query: SELECT moving_average(daily_tl, 42) - moving_average(daily_tl, 7) AS "TSB" FROM (SELECT sum("activityTrainingLoad") AS daily_tl FROM "ActivitySummary" WHERE $timeFilter AND "ActivitySelector" =~ /running/ GROUP BY time(1d) fill(0))

panels.title: Volume 7d (km)
panels.description: Cumulative running distance over the last 7 rolling days (current weekly load). Personal markers (periostitis history, proven cap ~32 km/wk): green <40 · amber 40–50 · red >50.

targets.query: SELECT moving_average(v,7)*7 AS "Vol7d" FROM (SELECT sum("distance")/1000 AS v FROM "ActivitySummary" WHERE $timeFilter AND "ActivitySelector" =~ /running/ GROUP BY time(1d) fill(0))

panels.title: Polarization — % Z1+Z2 (7d)
panels.description: Share of HR time in Z1+Z2 (easy) over the last 7 rolling days. Seiler target ≥ 80 %. Below 80 % = too much Z3 (grey zone). Red <70 · amber 70–80 · green ≥80.

targets.query: SELECT ma12*100/(ma12+ma3+ma45) AS "Z12pct" FROM (SELECT moving_average(z12,7) AS ma12, moving_average(z3,7) AS ma3, moving_average(z45,7) AS ma45 FROM (SELECT sum("hrTimeInZone_1")+sum("hrTimeInZone_2") AS z12, sum("hrTimeInZone_3") AS z3, sum("hrTimeInZone_4")+sum("hrTimeInZone_5") AS z45 FROM "ActivitySummary" WHERE $timeFilter AND "ActivitySelector" =~ /running/ GROUP BY time(1d) fill(0)))

panels.title: Monotony (Foster, 7d)
panels.description: Foster monotony = mean / standard deviation of daily load over 7 days. High = training too uniform (illness/staleness risk). Green <1.5 · amber 1.5–2.0 · red >2.0.

targets.query: SELECT moving_average(daily_tl, 7) / sqrt(moving_average(daily_tl_sq, 7) - moving_average(daily_tl, 7) * moving_average(daily_tl, 7)) AS "Monotony" FROM (SELECT sum("activityTrainingLoad") AS daily_tl, sum("activityTrainingLoad") * sum("activityTrainingLoad") AS daily_tl_sq FROM "ActivitySummary" WHERE $timeFilter AND "ActivitySelector" =~ /running/ GROUP BY time(1d) fill(0))

panels.title: HRV 7d (ms)
panels.description: Heart rate variability, 7-day average (ms). Higher = better recovered. Thresholds approximate, around the personal baseline (~69); the official Garmin status (Balanced/Low) is encoded by the dot color on the chart to the right.

targets.query: SELECT last("weeklyAvg") AS "HRV 7d" FROM "HRVStatus" WHERE $timeFilter GROUP BY time(1d) fill(null)
